arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Monthly customs (tariff) net receipts for 1974 (in millions)
values = [304, 239, 277, 286, 295, 301, 325, 355, 305, 347, 319, 307]

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(values) / len(values)
print(f"Monthly values: {values}")
print(f"Sum: {sum(values)}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate population-level standard deviation
# Using population formula (divide by N, not N-1)
variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in values) / len(values)
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population variance: {variance}")
print(f"Population std dev: {pop_std}")

# Calculate Coefficient of Variation
cv = (pop_std / mean) * 100
print(f"CV: {cv}")

# Round to nearest hundredths
cv_rounded = round(cv, 2)
print(f"CV rounded to nearest hundredths: {cv_rounded}")
EOF
